notes.subject: הכוס
notes.rationale: Liklik tarangau (KJV/JPS 'little owl') o pisin kotkot bilong nait; ol man i no wanbel long wanem animal em i tok

notes.subject: השלך
notes.rationale: Strong tok 'casting itself into the sea' — pisin bilong solwara o pelikan; no wanbel

notes.subject: השלך
notes.rationale: Tok hia em i wanpela nem bilong pisin, i no stap planti ples long Tanakh

translation: na ⟨את⟩ liklik tarangau, na ⟨את⟩ pisin bilong solwara i plaun long wara, na ⟨את⟩ bikpela tarangau bilong nait
